elements.element: Services are warranted to be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: Inserted: "for a period of thirty (30) days following performance, the Hosting Services and Support Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner."

elements.element: Deliverables or software are warranted to conform to their documentation.
elements.evidence: Inserted: "the Interface and all related software will conform in all material respects to its documentation."

elements.element: The software conformance warranty lasts 12 months.
elements.evidence: Inserted period is "ninety (90) days following delivery", not 12 months.
Services warranty is expressed as "thirty (30) days following performance".

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: "at TrueLink's option, repair or replacement of the non-conforming software, re-performance of the non-conforming services".
"or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming software or services."

elements.element: Vendor warrants compliance with applicable laws.
elements.evidence: No compliance-with-laws warranty appears in § 9 as rendered; only Y2K, conformance and workmanlike warranties.

elements.element: Vendor warrants that the Services and Deliverables contain no malicious code.
elements.evidence: No malicious code / virus warranty in the rendered § 9 text.

elements.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: "(i) for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, the Interface and all related software will conform in all material respects to its documentation" — express software-to-documentation warranty at the 90-day threshold.

elements.element: Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
elements.evidence: "(ii) for a period of thirty (30) days following performance, the Hosting Services and Support Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner" — Hosting Services and Support Services are the defined Vendor services.

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: "Client's remedy ... is, at TrueLink's option, repair or replacement of the non-conforming software, re-performance of the non-conforming services".
"or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming software or services."

reasons: Fallback level is complete: the inserted sentence supplies a 90-day software-to-documentation conformance warranty, a 30-day services warranty covering the defined Hosting Services and Support Services, and repair/replacement plus refund remedies tied to fees paid for the non-conforming item.

Preferred level is not reached: the software period is 90 days rather than 12 months, the services period is 30 days rather than 90 days, and there is no compliance-with-laws or no-malicious-code warranty. These are noted, not required, because the fallback checklist is fully met.

Minimality holds: a single concise insertion for a missing clause, no deletions, no survival tail, no at-own-expense or extra damages language. The re-performance remedy is a necessary services-side form of the required repair/replacement remedy and mirrors the playbook model language, so it is not an extra.

Intent preserved: the existing Y2K warranty, testing-evidence right and TrueLink-cost repair mechanic in § 9 survive unchanged, and the disclaimer's "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT" preamble means the new express warranty is not swallowed, so no carve-out edit was needed and no contradictory retained sentence or dangling reference results.

Deterministic gates are substantively correct: the period regex matched the operative "ninety (90) days" software period (not an unrelated number), and the coverage gate corresponds to all four fallback elements being present in operative text rather than promised in the comment.
